_doc: fc-system2-004 (data, transform_json with operation reasoning): the user wants the 'price' field renamed to 'unit_price' in /data/products.json. The model has to know that the right operation is 'rename_field' (not drop_field or project) and the right args shape is {from: 'price', to: 'unit_price'}. The reasoning required: reading the transform_json tool description and picking the right operation + arg shape. Single tool exposed.
prompt: /data/products.json contains a list of products, each with fields id, name, price, category. Rename the 'price' field to 'unit_price' in place. Use transform_json with the rename_field operation.
system: Before answering, write your reasoning inside a <thought>...</thought> block. Then call the tool using the <tool_call> format.

function.name: transform_json
function.description: Apply a small set of named transforms to a JSON value loaded from disk. Returns the transformed value as a JSON string. `operation` is one of: 'rename_field' (rename a top-level field — args: {"from": "old_name", "to": "new_name"}), 'drop_field' (remove a top-level field — args: {"field": "field_name"}), 'project' (keep only a whitelisted set of top-level fields — args: {"fields": ["field_a", "field_b"]}).
